slice: Your favorite verse is Psalm 23:1, which says, "The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want." This verse speaks to the comfort and guidance that God provides in our lives.

1. The Sabbath is observed on the seventh day of the week, which is Saturday. This is established in Genesis 2:2-3, where it states that God rested on the seventh day and sanctified it. Also, Exodus 20:8-11 commands to remember the Sabbath day to keep it holy. 2. Ecclesiastes 9:5
